title: The Second Hunger
summary: A second book of the devouring art that binds the foe's soul with a chain of hunger and takes a full mouthful of its force.

title: A Book of the Steady Drain
summary: A book of the long slow drain that holds a foe's soul while it feeds and teaches how to eat a taint from an ally's soul.

title: Treatise on Swallowing Strikes
summary: A short treatise on strikes of soul force that swallow whatever they touch and on the ward that eats a strike in return.

title: The Handbook of the Bottomless Maw
summary: A handbook for the practiced devourer on the bottomless maw that guards and chains and takes a last swallow from the broken.
